readings.moment: The temple struck nine at dinner, when the watches were put on the cloth
When the temple struck nine at dinner, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine
Félix heard the temple strike ten while alone in the library
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
A thump on the floor right above him, in the atelier
After the thump, the uncle's repeater struck ten slow deep notes
Someone came quickly down the stairs past the library door
Bastien Girard came into the library
The temple struck eleven, when Girard and Félix had been sitting together in the library

durations: Félix's watch ran twenty minutes behind the temple bell at nine (8:40 against 9:00)
The uncle had been four years on the repeater
Félix has had trouble with his father's watch for ten years
About three minutes between the thump at 10:18 and someone coming down the stairs at 10:21 (by Félix's watch)
About twenty-eight minutes between Girard entering the library at 10:32 and the temple striking eleven (Girard and Félix sat together)
whereabouts: At dinner, the uncle went round the table inspecting each family member's watch
Félix went up to the library after dinner
Félix had a glass of brandy, then another, in the library
Félix stayed in the library alone
Félix did not see who went up the stairs past the library door at 10:15; the door was shut
The thump came from the atelier, directly above the library, where the uncle's bench was
Félix was alone in the library directly under the uncle's bench when the thump came
Félix did not see who came down the stairs at 10:21; the door was shut
Félix stayed where he was in the library and finished the brandy
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 and sat with Félix until the temple struck eleven
Odile's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came
Girard laughed at dinner and Odile looked at her plate at dinner
